bagPolicy.summary: Standard-size school backpacks are allowed. Small and large luggage are not allowed inside the venue.
prohibited: Bags larger than a standard school backpack
bagPolicy.note: The luggage ban is part of France's Vigipirate security measures. Prohibited items cannot be left at the cloakroom.

parking.summary: The closest parking is QPark at 23 rue Bruno Coquatrix. Some on-street spaces in Paris are reserved for vehicles used by people with disabilities.

rideshare.summary: Concerto couldn't find a rideshare pickup zone published by L'Olympia. Set your pickup to the venue's address. After the show, use any signed pickup area, or walk a block or two from the main exit before you request a ride so your driver can reach you.

concessions.summary: The official FAQ describes a cloakroom, bar and food offerings; check its current services for the show.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: Reserved places are available for wheelchair users, with a companion seated nearby; your companion also needs a ticket. Wheelchair users can't be placed in the pit, and transfers to a seat aren't possible. For priority access, report to the security guards at the main entrance on the left side (Ekosport store side).

reEntry.summary: You can leave the hall after entry, but all exits are final and re-entry isn't allowed.

ticketPickup.summary: For ticket questions, contact the Olympia reservations team at the contact address or number on its FAQ.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: Guests with disabilities or temporary reduced mobility can get priority access by reporting to the security guards at the main entrance on the left side (Ekosport store side). Door times vary by event, so check your event page.
